title: Latency fingerprinting and regression-diff alerting per route/model/region
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a production-grade pipeline and interactive explorer that computes and surfaces p95/p99 latency fingerprints and change-detection alerts for each combination of API route, model variant, and region. The output should enable: (1) rapid triage when p95/p99 drifts, (2) root-cause pivoting by correlating tokens/sec and request shapes, and (3) safe rollouts via canary-level signal comparisons. This ticket covers ingestion schema, streaming aggregation, statistical comparison engine, alerting rules, and dashboard UX. We will support both synthetic load harness results and production telemetry, with clear provenance and backfills for historical baselines.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming job emits daily and hourly p95 and p99 aggregates keyed by route|model|region and request-size-bucket
Explorer dashboard shows fingerprint heatmap (rows=routes, cols=models) with per-region toggles and hoverable p95/p99 deltas
Regression-diff alerting rule triggers when baseline vs current p95/p99 diverge beyond statistical threshold (configurable) and creates an incident with example traces
Correlate token/sec and request length percentiles to distinguish load-induced regressions from model-side regressions
Backfill pipeline can compute fingerprints for last 90 days and mark the baseline window used for comparisons
End-to-end latency signal has automated tests in inferbench harness and a demo run in staging prior to prod rollout
design_notes: Fingerprinting: compute p50/p75/p90/p95/p99 and sample CDF per key using t-digest for memory efficiency
Regression test: two-sample KS test + bootstrap on p95/p99 difference to estimate significance and confidence intervals; surface both effect size and p-value
Storage trade-off: store hourly rollups + reservoir of raw traces for last 7d; full raw event retention is cost-prohibitive
Aggregation engine: leverage existing telemetry stream (Kafka -> Flink/Beam) to compute continuous rollups and emit to TimescaleDB / metric store
Alerting: use grouped alerting with silence windows and automatic deduplication for related route-model-region alerts
Sampling: deterministic sampling keyed by customer+route for reproducible example traces when alert fires

notes_for_oncall: If a regression alert fires: collect sample traces (deterministic sample id present in alert), compare tokens/sec and input length distribution, and attach staging vs prod fingerprint images to incident.
If multiple regions show identical deltas for same model: suspect model rollout; escalate to Model Ops and check rollout policy and model variant mapping.
